label: Start of line
description: Matches a position at the beginning of a line.

label: End of line
description: Matches a position at the end of a line.

label: Digit
description: Matches one number character.

label: Non-digit
description: Matches one character that is not a number.

label: Word character
description: Matches one letter, number, or underscore.
matches: u, s, e, r, _, i, d

label: Non-word character
description: Matches one character that is not a letter, number, or underscore.

label: Whitespace
description: Matches one space, tab, or newline.
matches: The space between A and B

label: Non-whitespace
description: Matches one character that is not a space, tab, or newline.

label: Any character
description: Matches any one character except a newline.

label: Zero or more
description: Repeats the previous item zero or more times.

label: One or more
description: Repeats the previous item one or more times.

label: Optional
description: Repeats the previous item zero or one time.

label: Exact count
description: Repeats the previous item exactly three times.

label: Count range
description: Repeats the previous item from two to five times.

label: Capture group
description: Groups part of a match so replacement text can reuse it.

label: Either/or
description: Matches the expression on the left or the right.

label: Character class
description: Matches one character listed inside the brackets.

label: Negated class
description: Matches one character not listed inside the brackets.

label: Word boundary
description: Matches the edge of a word.
matches: cat at the beginning and end with \bcat\b

label: Replacement group 1
description: Uses the first capture group in replacement text.

label: Replacement group 2
description: Uses the second capture group in replacement text.

label: Collapse blank lines
description: Finds three or more newlines and makes large vertical gaps smaller.

label: Trim line-end spaces
description: Finds extra spaces or tabs at the end of each line.

label: Swap date order
description: Finds dates like 2026-09-10 and captures year, month, and day.

label: Numbered list to bullets
description: Finds numbering at the beginning of a line.

label: Find lines containing text
description: Finds whole lines that contain a specific word.

label: Remove blank lines
description: Finds lines that contain only spaces or tabs, then removes the line.

label: Convert tabs to four spaces
description: Finds tab characters so indentation can be made consistent.

label: Repeated word
description: Uses \b for word edges, (\w+) to capture a word, \s+ for the gap, and \1 to find the same word again.

label: Text inside quotes
description: Uses literal quotes, then [^"\n]* to capture text that is not a quote or newline. The captured text can be reused as \1.

label: Matching HTML start/end tag
description: Captures the tag name with ([a-z][a-z0-9]*), then </\1> requires the same closing tag. .*? captures the shortest body text.

label: Line containing two words
description: Uses ^ and $ for the whole line, and .* to allow any text between the required words.
example_text: 受付のみ\n受付メール送信完了\n完了待ち

label: Japanese postal code
description: Uses \d{3} for three digits, a hyphen, then \d{4} for four digits.

label: Phone number
description: A practical simple pattern for Japanese hyphenated phone numbers with variable area-code lengths.

label: Comma-separated amount
description: Uses \d{1,3} for the first group, then (?:,\d{3})+ for one or more comma-plus-three-digit groups.

label: Integer or decimal
description: Makes the sign optional with [+-]?, requires digits with \d+, and makes the decimal part optional with (?:\.\d+)?.

label: Japanese address line
pattern: (東京都|北海道|(?:京都|大阪)府|.{2,3}県).+?[市区町村].+
description: A rough address pattern that starts with a prefecture-like name and then requires city, ward, town, or village text.
usage_example: (東京都|北海道|(?:京都|大阪)府|.{2,3}県).+?[市区町村].+

label: Management number
description: Finds two or more uppercase letters, a hyphen, and four or more digits, such as invoice or control numbers.

label: Slash date to hyphen date
description: Captures year, month, and day separately, then reorders them as \1-\2-\3 in replacement text.

label: Reorder CSV columns
description: Captures three comma-separated columns, then changes their order in replacement text.

label: Normalize colon variants
description: A character class matches one of the listed characters. This is useful for normalizing punctuation variants.

label: Trim leading and trailing spaces
description: | means OR. This finds spaces at the beginning of a line or spaces at the end of a line.
